assets.name: Race Garage
assets.scale_status: Proposed game-art dimensions, not measured CAD. Main body width/depth exclude attached stairs, balconies and eaves; total height includes roof/tower. Placement envelope is a blockout allowance for attachments, not a gameplay clearance or building code.
assets.silhouette: Two-bay cobalt-and-orange garage with a silver curved roof.
assets.roof_and_height: Shallow barrel roof: cylinder axis along +Y, curved front and rear profiles across X, straight side eave lines. Eave about 3.8 m; crown 4.8 m.
assets.opening_schedule: Front: two equal buggy bays. Right side: personnel door. Rear: two high vents. Left side: plain.
assets.construction_notes: Each bay clear opening 3.2 m wide by 3.0 m high; bay centers X=-2.1 and +2.1 m. Provide 6 m clear interior depth. Raised shutter geometry must stay above the opening. Add a simple closed interior lining.
assets.view_resolution: The sheet's SIDE view is arched and conflicts with a longitudinal barrel roof. Use the defined +Y barrel axis: side view should have a straight eave line. Front/rear arches share the same profile. This rule overrides the inconsistent inset.
assets.pivot: At ground level, horizontally centered on the FRONT main-wall baseline. Main body occupies X=-width/2..+width/2 and Y=0..depth; front attachments extend into negative Y.
assets.coordinates: Meters, +X right in front view, +Y into building from front facade, +Z up.
assets.variant_rules: Keep openings and overall scale consistent. Swap predefined paint regions, shutters, roof accents and optional lamps. Mirror only when balcony/stair access and roof attachments are also resolved.

assets.roof_and_height: Gable ridge along +Y, eave 2.8 m and ridge 4.2 m. Keep the small rear-right chimney/vent visible in the delivered image.
assets.opening_schedule: Front: central entry and a wide serving window on each side. Each side: one shuttered window. Rear: central stockroom door, two vents.

assets.view_resolution: The generated chimney was added beyond the initial prompt; retain it as a simple roof vent. Dark serving windows should have modeled recesses, not holes through an empty shell.
